component.name: DSPi Console
component.summary: Configure and tune a DSPi audio processor

description.p: DSPi Console controls a DSPi, open source DSP firmware that turns a Raspberry Pi Pico into a multi-output USB audio interface with an onboard signal processor.

Parametric EQ edited on the response graph, crossovers, routing, delay, a spectrum analyser, loudness, crossfeed, a tube modeller, a subharmonic synthesizer, a limiter on every output, control surfaces and firmware updates, all applied live over USB.
